newsitem.title: CHINA: Bell Labs to set up R&D facilities in China.
newsitem.headline: Bell Labs to set up R&D facilities in China.

text.p: Bell Labs, the research and development arm of Lucent Technologies Inc of the United States, will set up two research and development facilities in China, the Xinhua news agency said.
The facilities, in Beijing and Shanghai, would cost an estimated $4.0 million, Xinhua said.
Research would focus on optical, wireless, multimedia communications, digital signal processing, network planning and design, and software technology, it said.
The facilities would transfer technology to China and bring technology research into products for the Chinese market, Dan Stanzione, president of Bell Labs, was quoted as saying.
